name: ctf hoodie hd
description: Proposal, the HD take of the reworked ctf hoodie on the 60 cell lattice (8 px cells, the creature at 3x as in mushroom HD): it stands as itself in teal, a black hoodie drops over its head (a rounded hood with a teal lining round the face, the visor showing) and the black spreads down the body, a tug on the drawstrings; matrix rain falls behind it on empty cells only, a pixel font 404 flashes on the chest like a print, alert windows with a bang pop in the top corners while its eyes glance at each, then a magenta portal opens on the floor, it sinks through clipped at the rim, the portal closes, and it drops back in as itself and lands with a flash; judge whether the hoodie reads as a hoodie, whether the rain stays behind it, and whether the sink reads.
